posts.author: d paul
posts.content_md:
Hi there

I was wondering if anybody here has thought about using drygas for dehydrating out dcg holos? The stuff I am trying out is called ISO-HEET and seems to be reasonably high test IPA. It's cheap (1.59) and most auto stores carry it. When I tried it on the plates I made, it didn't melt them or chip at the image like the methanol version did. To be true I didn't get an image either ,but that I hold to the way I made the plates,and not to the alcohol.

posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md: I’m always using IPA for DCG holography, the easiest way to get the stuff is go to the nearest Walgreen’s or CVS and order a few pints of the 99% stuff. the guy wont like to look up the # in his book ,with persistence he will get it for you .... usually he can get it in 24 hours or less with no shipping cost.
